Subject: Re: Demo follow-up: security evidence & pen-test handoff for Acme Health

Thanks Michael — appreciate the recap. A few clarifying notes from Acme security: 

1) SOC 2: we need the latest SOC 2 Type II report or a redacted handback if you cannot share the full report. If a full report is unavailable, a management assertion + control mapping is acceptable for our procurement team.
2) Regulatory: confirm whether Redwood is comfortable signing a HIPAA BA for a limited set of PHI workflows (this is on the procurement checklist).
3) Pen test: we will run an external vendor (BlueWave). We need:
   - Expectation on read-only access windows and credential handling
   - Vulnerability disclosure SLA (we typically require 30/90/180 day triage milestones depending on severity)
   - A sample pen-test handback format (CSV/JSON) and remediation workflow so our ops team can integrate findings into Jira.

Can Monica or Neha share Redwood's standard disclosure SLAs and a scoping doc? Also please confirm if any production tokens/key rotation is required before a test.

Best,
Sara Lin
Head of Security, Acme Health
security@acmehealth.com

Sara —

Thanks for the detailed ask. Quick answers and attachments:

- SOC 2: attaching a redacted snapshot that highlights the in-scope services and our control mappings (SOC2_snapshot_Q1_2027.pdf). We can share the full Type II under NDA / mutual redaction — if procurement prefers, we can start that process.
- HIPAA BA: Redwood can sign a limited BA for customers that are processing PHI; I'll loop in legal for standard template. For scoping the BA we need to know exact data flows and retention windows.
- Pen-test handback & SLA: see attached scoping notes (redwood-pen-test-scoping-instructions.txt). Our standard vulnerability SLA is: Critical — 14 days to mitigation plan / 45 days to remediation; High — 30 days to mitigation plan / 90 days to remediation; Medium/Low — 90/180 days respectively. We can negotiate shorter windows for regulated controls if needed.

- Access: we offer temporary read-only API keys and an optional isolated test tenancy for vendor scans. No long-lived prod keys are provided; we require rotation after the test window.

Attachments included: SOC2_snapshot_Q1_2027.pdf, redwood-pen-test-scoping-instructions.txt. I'll populate the questionnaire and send back the XLSX in an hour.

Monica Patel
Security Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Thanks Monica — that helps. A couple quick points from procurement and infra: 

- Procurement: we'll confirm NDA requirements for full SOC2 within 48h; if Redwood can provide the redacted snapshot in the interim that's ideal.
- Infra: BlueWave prefers a 2-week window for blackbox testing and requests a low-privilege service account plus ephemeral token rotation instructions. Can Redwood provision the ephemeral token and a small test dataset that mimics production PII but is synthetic?

Can we aim to finalize the scope and calendar by Friday 5/21? If so, BlueWave can tentatively block 6/21-6/28 for testing.

Hi all —

Following up to lock in logistics. Per Acme's ask and internal alignment:

- Scope: External blackbox test of hosted API endpoints + auth flows. Excludes customer-managed private deployments.
- Window: BlueWave tentatively set for 2027-06-21 to 2027-06-28. Please confirm by 2027-05-28.
- Access & creds: We will issue an ephemeral read-only API token scoped to the test tenancy; token TTL 14 days. BlueWave will handle findings through our agreed CSV handback (sample in scoping doc).
- Disclosure SLA: Redwood proposes the standard SLA Monica outlined. If Acme requires accelerated windows for Critical findings, note in reply and we will route to the incident response team for an SLA amendment.
- Next step: John / Sara to confirm NDA path (procurement) and BlueWave to confirm the exact scan start date.

I've attached the filled vendor questionnaire as requested (vendor_security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx). Anything missing from the questionnaire, call it out and we will iterate quickly.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
